items.title: vlt 1.0 Ships as a Drop-in npm Replacement with Phased Installs, Graph Queries, and Malware-Blocking
items.blurb: vlt, created by the original npm team, has launched version 1.0 as a drop-in replacement for npm.

items.title: Have the frontier labs mixed up AI safety and security?
items.blurb: The recent agent sandbox escapes at OpenAI and Anthropic look less like a technical failure and more like a philosophical one - treating security controls as though they only need to work most of the time.
